newsitem.title: USA: Boeing gets helicopter order from INS.
newsitem.headline: Boeing gets helicopter order from INS.

text.p: Boeing Co said late Tuesday that the U.S. Immigration and Naturalization Service plans to buy 45 MD 600N helicopters with a total value, including aircraft, spares and support, of estimated $70.7 million.
The company said the order amounts to an agency endorsement of advanced technology helicopters over conventional rotorcraft.
The MD 600Ns will be assigned to the U.S. Border Patrol operating sectors between San Diego, Calif., and Miami, Fla., as replacement aircraft for its fleet of OH-6A helicopters, Boeing said.

Boeing said the contract award is the largest commercial helicopter order in more than 20 years for its helicopter subsidiary in Mesa, Ariz., which also produces MD 500 Series and MD Explorer helicopters.
The award calls for delivery of nine MD 600N helicopters the first year and options for nine more MD 600Ns each year for four additional years. First delivery will be in early 1998, the company said.
